# Tru Booth

> Tru Booth (also Tru Photobooth) is a premium photo booth rental company based in Cairo, Egypt. It rents a closed (enclosed) photo booth, in Black or Red, and an open photo booth for weddings, engagements and katb ketab, birthdays, graduations, baby showers and sebou, henna nights, Ramadan and Eid gatherings, corporate events, exhibitions and conferences, family days, New Year's and holiday parties, concerts, festivals and beach parties, with prints on the spot in a custom strip design. It also makes Tru Photo Books, hardcover photobooks made from customers' own photos, ordered online at https://trubooth.com/photobook, printed in Cairo and delivered across Egypt. It serves Greater Cairo and Giza, the North Coast (Sahel) and El Gouna, and runs permanent and seasonal booths at Majarrah Mall (Sheikh Zayed) and Seashell Hill Walk (North Coast).

Key facts:
- A standard booking covers up to 4 hours or 216 prints, whichever comes first; extra prints come in packs of 108.
- Every booking includes a custom strip design, an on-site attendant, setup before doors open and teardown.
- "Closed photo booth" is the common Egyptian name for an enclosed booth. Tru's closed booths are The Black and The Red; the open booth is a normal open photo booth for big groups.
- Walk-in at Majarrah Mall, Sheikh Zayed: Tru's closed booth The Black, no booking, pay per print; open Sunday to Thursday 5 PM to 11 PM, Friday and Saturday 5 PM to midnight; the North Coast booth runs in summer only.
- The booth needs about 2 × 2 m of floor, one power outlet, and runs fully offline (no Wi-Fi).
- Add-ons: video messages recorded in the booth (delivered within a week) and A4 hardcover photobooks.
- Tru Photo Books (https://trubooth.com/photobook): printed photobooks made from the customer's own photos, for any occasion, no booth booking needed. Ordered online: upload your photos and the shop lays out the book (or fill a ready-made edition, or upload your own A4 PDF); you can change any page, then approve the proof, and nothing is printed before you approve.
- The book: A4 hardcover (21 × 29.7 cm), 200 gsm matte paper, 26 pages (about 35 to 60 photos) or 50 pages (about 70 to 120 photos), extra pages in blocks of four. The cover can carry your own photo, a title and a year, in English or Arabic. Editions: Weddings & Katb Ketab, Sahel & Summer, Travel, Baby's First Year, Graduations. Printed and bound in Cairo.
- Delivery and payment: delivered to the buyer's door from Alexandria to Aswan (the governorate is chosen at checkout), or collected at a Tru booth chosen at checkout (such as Majarrah Mall in Sheikh Zayed or Pulse Island in Cairo); paid in cash on delivery or at the booth, nothing in advance. The shop does not promise a delivery date: a paid Rush option puts a book first in the print queue, and a private order page follows each order. A gift is delivered to the buyer, who hands it over; gift wrap comes with a card (the recipient's name and a message). Each order holds one book and, optionally, one second copy. A damaged or faulty book is reprinted or refunded if reported within 30 days. Prices are shown in the shop.
- Photobook gifts by occasion: Mother's Day (21 March in Egypt) and gifts for parents, Valentine's Day (14 February) and Egypt's own Love Day (4 November) and anniversaries, birthdays, a new baby's first year and the sebou, weddings, graduations, farewells and retirements.
- Prices are quoted per event; quotes for events outside Cairo include transport. No prices are published.
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone +20 102 138 4170, truphotoboothelghayesh@gmail.com, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/trubooth/. Inquiry form: https://trubooth.com/contact/
- The website is available in English and in Arabic (under /ar/).

- [What is a photo booth?](https://trubooth.com/guides/what-is-a-photo-booth/): A photo booth is a small photo studio set up at an event, with a camera, a screen, a light and a printer, where guests take their own photos and leave with a printed strip within seconds. Tru Booth runs enclosed and open photo booths, each with an attendant, across Greater Cairo, the North Coast (Sahel) and El Gouna. Our enclosed booth needs about 2 × 2 metres and one power outlet, but no Wi-Fi. To book, send your date and venue on WhatsApp or through the inquiry form.
- [Open vs enclosed booth](https://trubooth.com/guides/open-vs-enclosed-photo-booth/): Open vs enclosed photo booth comes down to privacy against group size: an enclosed (closed) booth gives guests a private space behind walls, while an open booth has no walls, so a big group fits in one frame. Choose enclosed for weddings, engagements and formal nights where candid photos matter most; choose open when guests arrive in big groups. Tru Booth offers both across Greater Cairo, the North Coast (Sahel) and El Gouna, each with a custom strip and an attendant. Send your date and venue on WhatsApp and we suggest the right one.
- [Choosing a wedding photo booth](https://trubooth.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-wedding-photo-booth/): To choose a wedding photo booth in Egypt, check twelve points before you book: booth type, prints included and what happens after the limit, print quality, custom design, the attendant, setup and access, space and power, offline operation, hall rules, timing in the programme, add-ons, and the details a quote needs. Tru Booth rents enclosed and open photo booths for weddings across Greater Cairo, the North Coast (Sahel) and El Gouna. Send your date and venue on WhatsApp or through the inquiry form, and we reply with a quote.
- [How many prints you need](https://trubooth.com/guides/how-many-photo-booth-prints/): How many photo booth prints you need depends on four numbers: your guests, the share who use the booth, how many people go in each session, and how many copies each session prints. One print is a 4 × 6 inch sheet that carries two strips. A standard Tru Booth booking in Cairo, on the North Coast or in El Gouna covers up to 216 prints or 4 hours, whichever comes first, and extra prints come in packs of 108. - [How to make a photobook](https://trubooth.com/guides/how-to-make-a-photobook/): To make a photobook, decide what the book is about, gather the original photo files, choose more than you need and cut down, put them in order (by time, place or person), and pick a page count: as a rule of thumb, about 35 to 60 photos for 26 pages and 70 to 120 for 50. Send originals rather than WhatsApp-forwarded copies, which are compressed. Tru Photo Books prints the result as an A4 hardcover on 200 gsm matte paper in Cairo and delivers it across Egypt.
- [Where to print a photobook](https://trubooth.com/guides/where-to-print-a-photobook-in-egypt/): Before you print a photobook in Egypt, check six things: the size, the paper weight and finish, the binding, where it is printed, how it reaches you, and how your photo files are handled. Tru Photo Books prints your own photos as an A4 hardcover (21 × 29.7 cm), case-bound, with 26 or 50 pages of 200 gsm matte paper, printed and bound in Cairo, and delivers across Egypt or hands it over at a Tru booth. You make it online at trubooth.com/photobook, approve the proof and pay in cash on delivery.
- [Photobook vs photo album](https://trubooth.com/guides/photobook-vs-photo-album/): A photobook is printed directly on its pages and bound like a book, so the photos and the layout are one object; a photo album holds separate prints in sleeves or on sticky pages that you fill yourself. A photobook is slimmer, lasts better and reads as a story; an album is easy to add to over time. Tru Photo Books makes photobooks: an A4 hardcover from your own photos, 26 or 50 pages of 200 gsm matte paper, printed and bound in Cairo and delivered across Egypt.
- [Photobook ideas](https://trubooth.com/guides/photobook-ideas/): Good photobook ideas start from a clear subject: a wedding or katb ketab, a summer or a trip, a baby’s first year, a gift for a parent or grandparents, graduation, a group of friends, a year in twelve months, Ramadan and Eid with the family, a pet, a home, or a night at a photo booth. One person collects everyone’s photos, lays out the book online and approves the proof; the book is delivered to them anywhere in Egypt or collected at a Tru booth, and paid in cash when it arrives. At A4 it still fits in a carry-on bag.

## The Tru Photo Books shop

- [Make your photo book](https://trubooth.com/photobook): upload your photos, approve the proof, pay in cash on delivery.
- [Wedding & Katb Ketab edition](https://trubooth.com/photobook/occasions/wedding): 50 pages, title and date on the spine.
- [Baby's First Year edition](https://trubooth.com/photobook/occasions/baby): 26 pages, a caption or date on any page.
- [Graduation edition](https://trubooth.com/photobook/occasions/graduation): the degree, university and year on the cover.
- [Sahel & Summer edition](https://trubooth.com/photobook/occasions/sahel-summer): North Coast and Gouna summers.
- [Travel edition](https://trubooth.com/photobook/occasions/travel): trips, with ready-made covers.
- [Ready-made books](https://trubooth.com/photobook/templates): every page laid out; your photos fill the frames.
- [Print your own layout](https://trubooth.com/photobook/own-layout): upload an A4 PDF with 3 mm bleed.
- [Terms of sale](https://trubooth.com/photobook/terms): proof approval, cash payment, delivery, faults and refunds.

- [فوتو بوك عيد الأم](https://trubooth.com/ar/photobooks/mothers-day-photobook/): في عيد الأم في مصر، يوم 21 مارس، فوتو بوك من Tru Photo Books هدية معمولة من صور العيلة نفسها: الصور القديمة المطبوعة واللي على موبايلات الكل، في هارد كفر مقاس A4 بـ 26 أو 50 صفحة، مطبوع ومتجلّد في القاهرة. بترتّبه أونلاين، وتوافق على البروفة، ويوصلك لحد الباب في أي مكان في مصر أو تستلمه من بوث Tru، وبتدفع كاش لما يوصل. وينفع هدية لماما، أو لحماتك، أو لتيتا، أو لبابا وماما مع بعض في عيد جوازهم.
- [فوتو بوك عيد الحب وعيد الجواز](https://trubooth.com/ar/photobooks/anniversary-valentines-photobook/): فوتو بوك من Tru Photo Books هدية لعيد الجواز أو عيد الحب، معمولة من صوركم انتو الاتنين: اتقابلتوا إزاي، الخطوبة وكتب الكتاب، الفرح، السفريات والأيام العادية، في هارد كفر مقاس A4 مطبوع ومتجلّد في القاهرة. مصر بتحتفل بعيد الحب (الفالنتين) يوم 14 فبراير، وبعيد الحب المصري يوم 4 نوفمبر. بترتّب البوك أونلاين، وتوافق على البروفة، وبتدفع كاش لما يوصلك لحد الباب أو لما تستلمه من بوث Tru، عشان يفضل مفاجأة.
- [فوتو بوك عيد الميلاد](https://trubooth.com/ar/photobooks/birthday-photobook/): فوتو بوك من Tru Photo Books هدية عيد ميلاد معمولة من صورك انت لصاحب عيد الميلاد: السنة اللي عدّت من آخر عيد ميلاد، أو عمره كله في عيد ميلاد مهم زي الـ 18 أو 21 أو 30 أو 40 أو 50 أو 60، في هارد كفر مقاس A4 بـ 26 أو 50 صفحة، مطبوع ومتجلّد في القاهرة. انت بتجمّع الصور، وتجهّز البوك أونلاين، وتوافق على البروفة. والبوك بيوصلك انت في أي مكان في مصر، أو تستلمه من بوث Tru، وتدفع كاش عند الاستلام.
- [فوتو بوك أول سنة للبيبي](https://trubooth.com/ar/photobooks/baby-first-year-photobook/): فوتو بوك أول سنة من Tru Photo Books بيحوّل صور أول 12 شهر في عمر البيبي لبوك هارد كفر مقاس A4 بـ 26 صفحة، فيه حوالي 35 لـ 60 صورة، مع تعليق أو تاريخ على أي صفحة، مطبوع ومتجلّد في القاهرة. الأب والأم بيعملوه ذكرى ليهم، والجدود والخالات والعمات والصحاب بيقدّموه هدية، غالباً في أول عيد ميلاد؛ وبوك أول أسابيع ينفع كمان هدية سبوع للمولود. بترفع الصور على نسخة Baby’s First Year (أول سنة للبيبي) في المتجر، وتوافق على البروفة، وتدفع كاش عند الاستلام، سواء وصلك في أي مكان في مصر أو استلمته من بوث Tru.
- [فوتو بوك الوداع والتقاعد](https://trubooth.com/ar/photobooks/farewell-retirement-photobook/): فوتو بوك من Tru Photo Books بيبقى هدية وداع أو هدية تقاعد من المجموعة كلها: صوركم مع صاحب مسافر برا مصر، أو زميل سايب الشغل، أو مدير طالع على المعاش، في هارد كفر مقاس A4 بـ 26 أو 50 صفحة، مطبوع ومتجلّد في القاهرة. شخص واحد بيجمّع صور الكل، ويجهّز البوك أونلاين، ويوافق على البروفة؛ والبوك بيوصل للشخص ده في أي مكان في مصر أو يستلمه من بوث Tru، والدفع كاش عند الاستلام. وحتى وهو مقاس A4، بيدخل في شنطة الهاند كاري.
